scope: Focused trusted local runtime proof, separate from actual CLI delivery trials.

derivedBaseComparison.derivation: Unified comparison of recorded Git base and original selected snapshot; does not replace the empty historical recorded patch.

environment.credentialPolicy: Ephemeral signed RS256 JWTs; no token or private key written to evidence

checks.observation: Running backend health and web identify this revision and local proof environment.
Creating through the web is visible in a fresh authenticated Convex read.
Web done/reopen actions survive independent reads; MCP observes reopened status, and MCP done survives a web reload.
Another signed user cannot read or mutate the first user’s item through Convex or MCP.
MCP denies anonymous, web-audience, wrong-audience and expired credentials; Convex denies anonymous/wrong-audience reads.
Malformed status arguments are rejected and the UI resource contains its required JS/CSS.
The MCP resource applies initial and updated host styles, acknowledges teardown, remounts, and changes persisted status through AppBridge and web reloads.
No uncaught web JavaScript error was observed during the create/reload journey.
Disposable issuer verifies auth boundaries. Live WorkOS sign-in, refresh and organization lifecycle require a configured test tenant.
Local AppBridge host was exercised. Installed ChatGPT OAuth, tool selection and UI behavior were not run.

coverage: R4 now calls work_items_list as the second signed MCP user, validates its structured items, and asserts the first owner item is absent; it also verifies Convex read isolation and specific Convex/MCP mutation denial.
gapPolicy: G1 WorkOS live sign-in/refresh/lifecycle and G2 installed ChatGPT OAuth/tool/UI were skipped; local proof does not close these gaps.

archive.policy: Only observed personal host prefixes and macOS temporary roots are replaced in exported UTF8 copies; original local files are untouched. Synthetic checked-in test credentials and public Bearer challenge syntax are retained as source, with their pattern counts disclosed. Supported PNG files are byte-exact. No earlier outcome, source content, manifest or empty patch is repaired.
